plus.analyst_notes:
Closes https://github.com/vz-risk/VCDB/issues/24274
Encoded by AI — encode-veris-incident skill version 20260801T010623Z
Template Malware-ext-Ransomware-databreach followed, plus social Extortion for the documented 30 BTC demand (refused - integrity Alter behavior still coded per skill). Coded from the issue body and pipeline comment summaries (WebFetch budget exhausted). Year: issue body and the BleepingComputer summary say 2024 and SafeState says 2025, but the Milliyet/AA piece is dated 30.08.2026 and tech-insider says August 7, 2026 - coded exfiltration start Aug 7 2026 as incident date, isolation Aug 14 (discovery ~7 days). Reviewer should confirm year. Encryption not explicitly confirmed; availability Obscuration/Interruption per template and service disruption. Data scope is largely attacker-claimed (Rhysida) and partly confirmed by Berlin; data_total omitted (1.44M files, not records); issue body mentions personal info of over 12,000 people. NAICS 921190 chosen (state administration network; department spans transport/environment). Employee count Unknown. Ignored PHIDBR2019 tag.

summary: Rhysida ransomware operators compromised the Berlin Senate Department for Mobility, Transport, Climate Protection and Environment (and partly the Department for Urban Development), exfiltrating about 5.79 TB / 1.44 million files between August 7 and 12, 2026 before the departments were isolated on August 14. Stolen data reportedly includes government, legal, financial, HR and infrastructure records, personal contact data, 148 IBANs, plaintext credentials, identity documents and classified material. Rhysida listed Berlin on its leak site on August 28 and demanded 30 BTC (~EUR 2 million); Berlin confirmed the data theft and refused to pay. Services such as housing benefit processing were disrupted.
